apple-inspired.description: System typography, generous radii, quiet layered surfaces.

material-design.description: Distinct elevation, legible controls, strong focus indicators.

fluent-design.description: Layered surfaces, restrained depth and familiar navigation.

linux-inspired.description: Functional controls and dense, direct navigation.

glassmorphism.description: Translucent panels; maintain opaque fallback and text contrast.

matte-glass.description: Frosted surfaces with readable solid content areas.

neumorphism.description: Soft depth; input boundaries remain visible without shadows.

bento.description: Modular grids with a consistent spacing rhythm.

futuristic.description: Technical typography, precise outlines and monitoring panels.

minimal.description: Whitespace, strong hierarchy and minimal ornament.

brutalism.description: Heavy outlines, direct typography and sharp corners.

flat.description: Solid fills, clear hierarchy and little elevation.

retro.description: Warm surfaces and expressive headings with readable body text.

cyberpunk.description: Dark technical surfaces; neon remains an accent.

corporate.description: Predictable information hierarchy and restrained branding.

editorial.description: Serif headlines, long-form rhythm and clear content hierarchy.

monochrome.description: Hierarchy through spacing, weight and accessible neutral contrast.

industrial.description: Sturdy borders, compact controls and operational clarity.

luxury.description: Refined headings, warm accents and generous whitespace.

custom.description: Compose tokens intentionally; document deviations in decisions.md.
